question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Should Brendan and Dinah stay together?
Have you ever helped a friend get over someone?
options: I tried... But it didn't work.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Well, the first thing Howard needs to do is find a way to look backwards and appraise his relationship honestly.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I'm not sure I get what that means.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: It's easy to remember only the good parts of a relationship. But if you broke up, that means there were some bad parts too.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Realizing that can help a person move on.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Okay... That sounds like pretty solid advice to me.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Linda leafed through her photo album and tried to objectively analyze her dates with Howard.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh... I don't think Howard has a photo album, but maybe... I know!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I could look through the videotapes Mallika recorded for the senior retrospective to find shots of Howard and Linda together. What do you think?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I think that's a great idea! You should head over to the A.V. Lab first thing tomorrow.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Thanks, Dinah!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Sure. Of course, it's girly!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Okay? So...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: But Howard's problem is a girl!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh, I get it! Sometimes you have to fight fire with fire!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Exactly!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Well, it sounds like you have some ideas. Let's hear them.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Goth? Brendan, I thought we were past that already. Sure, I wear black clothes and make-up that makes me paler, but that doesn't mean I don't have feelings.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Dinah, I'm sorry... I...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: People are people... Whether they play football or like computer games or visit the cemeteries of deceased punk musicians.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I guess you're right.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Anyway, I have some ideas if you still want to hear them.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Of course!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Well, I'm not surprised. I've been helping Linda get over the break-up, and it's been pretty tough going. We've done everything... Healing spells, seances, romantic comedies and ice cream.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You... You watched a romantic comedy?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Sure... I mean, 'Pull Me to Purgatory' has some romantic elements, right? Anyway, my point is that break-ups are never easy for anyone.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Thanks for your help, Dinah, but those suggestions sound a little...
As Brendan exits the field, Dinah walks up...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Wow! Did Zach really drag you all the way to the football field?!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yep... And talk about rug burn!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Ouch. Will you be okay?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Honestly, I'm more concerned about Howard. I never even suspected he was in such rough shape.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: We've got a really crucial game against `Highlands Academy` coming up this week. If Howard doesn't play well, Coach is going to bench him for the rest of the season.
nodes.text_bbcode: We've got a really crucial game against [color=#e23b3b][i]Highlands Academy[/i][/color] coming up this week. If Howard doesn't play well, Coach is going to bench him for the rest of the season.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Bench him?! That sounds drastic. Are you sure?

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Howard, how many times do I have to tell you? Stop punching that tackle dummy!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Yeah. Pretty sure.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Look, twerp, I want you to take Howard out, show him a good time, and get his head clear for the big game. Can you do that?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Of course! Howard is my friend. I'll do everything I can to help, but...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: It's just... Isn't this more Hector's area of expertise?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Just because I'm over Amanda, doesn't mean I'm cool with what Hector did. That means he's out, and you're in, okay?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah, sure.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Thanks, Bernard. You're a real pal!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: No problem.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Yeah, of course. That makes sense. It's like that thing Coach always says when we're not playing hard enough, 'Time heals all head wounds'.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Okay, so since we agree, maybe you should give Howard some `time` and then...
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, so since we agree, maybe you should give Howard some [color=#e23b3b][i]time[/i][/color] and then...

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: `WRONG!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]WRONG!!![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: But you said...

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Sure. Giving Howard time would be a great idea... `If we had any!` Haven't you been paying attention to the football schedule?
nodes.text_bbcode: Sure. Giving Howard time would be a great idea... [color=#e23b3b][i]If we had any![/i][/color] Haven't you been paying attention to the football schedule?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Space? No kidding. When Amanda dumped me, all I could think about was getting away from everything.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: But after a long weekend spear-fishing halibut with my Uncle Lou, I was primed to move on with my life. I mean, I don't even think about Amanda anymore...

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Not her silky red hair, her infectious giggle, or the way she would turn the toaster upside down to find out where the bread went.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: I'd tell her... You're eating it, Amanda-Bear. The bread is called toast now.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: It sounds like that fishing trip really... Helped?!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Totally! It's good to know we're working on the same wavelength here. So let me give you the scoop on the football schedule.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: I mean, come on... He's a wide receiver! He should be catching passes, not shoulder checking the quarterback!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Then today, he tackled me during line drills and gave me one of those... Uh... Uh... What do you call those things you get where you can't think straight?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: A concussion?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Come on, doofus. I thought you nerds were supposed to be smart. What he did was `knock me upside the head!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Come on, doofus. I thought you nerds were supposed to be smart. What he did was [color=#e23b3b][i]knock me upside the head![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Look, Zach, I get it. You had an accident, and now you're overreacting.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Trust me. I talk to Howard every day. Sure he was upset about the break-up at first, but he's gotten over it. He's fine now.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Fine? Fine?! Is that what you think? Let's take a walk.
Zach seizes Brendan by the collar, drags him kicking and screaming from the Computer Lab...
And deposits him on the sidelines of the football field.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: There! Does that look 'fine' to you?

nodes.speaker: Quarterback
nodes.text: And `hike!`
nodes.text_bbcode: And [color=#e23b3b][i]hike![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Quarterback
nodes.text: Howard, what are you doing?! You're supposed to go long! You're supposed to--

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: RAAAAARRRRRR!!!
Howard tackles the quarterback.

nodes.speaker: Quarterback
nodes.text: AIIYYEEEEE!!! MY FEMUR!!!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Dad gummit! Howard, what in the world were you thinking?!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Whoa... You weren't kidding!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: But that doesn't change the fact that Howard seemed fine in all of the classes we had together.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: He must be bottling up his negative emotions and then unleashing them on the football field.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Yeah, like I said... Totally aggro.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Well, now that I know Howard is still upset, I'd say that what he needs is some...

nodes.prompt: I'd say that what he needs is some...

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: I'd say that what he needs is some...

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Well... You and Howard are buddies, right?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah, of course. He's my best friend.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Great! Then you're just the man I need to speak to!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Wait a minute... Is something wrong?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: I'll say... Ever since Linda dumped Howard, he's been going totally aggro on the football field.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: You don't have time to speak to me?!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Well, yeah... As you can see, I'm kind of in the middle of a deathmatch here.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: That's funny. Looks to me like you're `losing` a deathmatch.
nodes.text_bbcode: That's funny. Looks to me like you're [color=#e23b3b][i]losing[/i][/color] a deathmatch.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: But then again, I guess that's what you get for using a Teslonian Lightning Staff against an Arcticazian Snow Elf.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: But... But... How did you...?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Next time, you should try using the Pyronian Broadsword you get in the Kraktoan Deepshire instance.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Wow... That's actually good advice. Is there something I can help you with?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Yeah, actually... Ever since Linda dumped Howard, he's been going totally aggro on the football field.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I know! Spike's been begging us to play paintball with him for weeks!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I've been blowing him off because, well, you know, scared of pain... But this is too perfect to pass up!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I'll call him up and secure the range!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Thanks, Dinah. You're the best!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Impractical?!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Dinah... First off, I doubt Howard is going to sit still long enough to learn how to sew a cloak. And shimmery velvet? He'd sooner wear pink cashmere!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Brendan...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: And what about thimbles?! Do you not find the idea of tiny, iron-plated finger gloves to be absolutely creepy?!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Brendan!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh... Yes?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: The point was the `mission`, not the cloak.
nodes.text_bbcode: The point was the [color=#3b78e2][i]mission[/i][/color], not the cloak.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh, well in that case, I suppose it's not such a terrible idea.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Not such a terrible...?! And what's the deal with you and thimbles?!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh... I, uh... I don't like to talk about it. But about the mission...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: It is...?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Totally! I mean, you've really tapped into masculine psychology! Howard `does` need to go on a mission. But shopping isn't the right activity. Girls gather. Boys hunt.
nodes.text_bbcode: Totally! I mean, you've really tapped into masculine psychology! Howard [color=#e23b3b][i]does[/i][/color] need to go on a mission. But shopping isn't the right activity. Girls gather. Boys hunt.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: So... You're going to take Howard hunting?!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: No! I mean, the last thing I want to do is hurt anything, but maybe...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: And it didn't go too well.
Brendan's phone rings.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh... Hello?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Hey, Brendan!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Dinah! I was just thinking about you.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: You were?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah, I mean... I just finished showing Howard the tape.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: And?
Brendan cues up the tape. The television displays...
The `pep rally...`
nodes.text_bbcode: The [b]pep rally...[/b]

nodes.text: Howard and Linda stand on the stage as Zach addresses the assembled student body.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: And I promise you... This football team is like a well-oiled machine! We will play Highlands Academy this season, and we will win!
The crowd cheers! All except for Linda...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What?! That pep rally was really important to me! But when I see it from this angle, it seems like Linda wasn't having a good time at all.
On screen, the camera pans over...
Capturing Kenji as he slips into the gymnasium. Linda smiles as Kenji enters.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Huh... I guess things aren't always exactly like you remember them. I need to go home and think about this.
As Howard exits, Brendan looks back to the television. On screen, there are reaction shots of the crowd...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hey! That's me! And Dinah is sitting right behind me! She's got a Warscrewdriver: Online strategy guide, and she's taking notes...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: But this movie was shot months before she helped my in-game character with the quest to retrieve the PryBlade of Perfidius.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I was still dating Kat then. Why would she be interested in Warscrewdriver: Online unless... Unless...?
On screen, Dinah looks up from the strategy guide and gazes at Brendan fondly.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: No, it couldn't be... Does Dinah actually...?
Brendan cues up the tape. The television displays...
The `school dance...`
nodes.text_bbcode: The [b]school dance...[/b]

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Dancing with you tonight, I almost wish this moment would never end.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's pretty perfect, isn't it?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Well... There's one thing that could make it better.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: If they played our song.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, about that...

nodes.speaker: Disc Jockey
nodes.text: May I have your attention. By special request, we're about to play the classic 'Girl, Will You Be My Lady'! This one's for you, Linda!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Oh Howard!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Wow... You guys were really good together. Why'd you two break up again?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: This is terrible! I was already miserable, and now you made me watch a tape of the best night of my life?! What's the matter with you?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Howard, I'm sorry. I...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Thanks but no thanks, Brendan!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Ouch... I should let Dinah know the video idea didn't go so well.
Later that night, Howard hangs out in Brendan's den...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay... So what am I doing here again? When you called me up, you said it was important that I get over here A.S.A.P.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: It was... I mean, it `is` important!
nodes.text_bbcode: It was... I mean, it [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] important!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Howard, the thing is... I know that you've been pretty distraught over your break-up with Linda.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Dinah and I thought that if I could help you appraise your relationship honestly, you might be able to see that things with Linda weren't as great as you remember them.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And we're going to do that by showing me a movie?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Exactly! I have two digital videotapes. One is from a pep rally you attended just a few days after you and Linda started dating. The other is from the school dance you two went to last month.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hmm... I need to pick the tape that best demonstrates that Howard and Linda were having problems before they broke up.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: We're going to watch...
search

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Brendan, I understand what you're trying to do for Howard, and I'd love to help you find some footage of Howard and Linda together...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: But unfortunately, Mrs. Lumiere, the A.V. Studies instructor, is really paranoid about who gets access to the film vault.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I think it has something to do with the time that Wilson High inserted footage of a dancing badger into the school's welcome video.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Mallika, I wouldn't be asking if this wasn't important.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Um... Well... Fine. Fine! I'll help... But I'm only doing this because I feel sorry for Howard, and I want him to be happy.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Now, I know Mrs. Lumiere keeps the key to the film vault around here somewhere. If you could find it before she gets back from lunch, you should be able to open the vault and select a few tapes.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: In the meantime, I'll stand guard outside and let you know when Mrs. Lumiere gets back. Are you ready?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Time's wasting! Let's do this!
As Mallika steps out into the hall, Brendan searches the A.V. Studies classroom from top to bottom...
And finds the key!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Ha! It was under a snow globe with the word 'Rosebud' painted on the base... How much more obvious could you be?
Brendan uses the key to open the door to the film vault. He steps inside...
And finds himself in a room stacked floor-to-ceiling with digital videotapes, hard drives, and film canisters.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Whoa! There are thousands of movies in here... And that's just from this year?! How could they possibly record this much footage?
Brendan carefully thumbs through the labels and selects several promising titles. Then from outside the classroom, Brendan hears...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Kaw-Kaw! Kaw-kaw!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: That's the signal! Time to book!
Brendan steps out into the hallway.

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Lumiere
nodes.text: Mallika, I'm very disappointed in you. You know the A.V. Lab access rules!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: But he... He...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: But I'm in your third period class!

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Lumiere
nodes.text: You are? You don't look very familiar.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: That's because I'm... I'm wearing movie make-up to dramatically change my appearance. Just like in that one film you like...

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Lumiere
nodes.text: Oh! You mean 'The Pinkish Scarpernel'! I do love that movie! Weren't the special effects innovative?

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Lumiere
nodes.text: Well, if you know I love that movie, I guess you really must be in my class. Carry on.
Mrs. Lumiere exits into her classroom.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Whoo! That was close. Good thinking, Brendan!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: And thank you, Mallika. I'm sure these tapes will help Howard.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Perfect! Now all I have to do is invite Howard over for an impromptu movie night!
But comes up empty!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I've checked inside film canisters, behind the movie posters, and even underneath the editing bays. The key isn't anywhere!
From outside the classroom, Brendan hears...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Kaw-Kaw!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: So soon...? Oh well. Better to leave empty-handed than to get caught red-handed.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: That was close, Brendan! Too close. And you didn't even get the tape, did you?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I looked all around, but...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Save it... Just go wait outside, and I'll see what I can do.
A few moments later, Mallika exits the school. She crosses to Brendan.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: After you left, Mrs. Lumiere opened up the vault to retrieve footage of the football team.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: While she was inside, I managed to grab two tapes for you. They're not the best, but there might be something you can use to cheer Howard up.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Wow... Thanks, Mallika!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Anyway, maybe you're right. Maybe Howard `does` need to talk to some girls. I'll call up Hector and see if he has any ideas.
nodes.text_bbcode: Anyway, maybe you're right. Maybe Howard [color=#e23b3b][i]does[/i][/color] need to talk to some girls. I'll call up Hector and see if he has any ideas.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: If you're my friend, you should be happy for me. I mean, it's not like I'm dating anyone right now.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I know, but... But...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Who cares if some random guy thinks I'm cute?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I just... Dinah, you're totally cute! You just shouldn't need some scraggly mall rat to tell you that.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: You... You think I'm cute?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah! I mean, definitely!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: You know... It's... It's kind of nice to hear you say that.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Huh... That was kind of awkward, but it felt good too!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Seriously, talking to strangers! What were you thinking?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Brendan, they were just normal guys.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Or were they?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Yes! Yes, they were! Brendan, what's going on with you?!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Are you jealous...?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh... What?! Of some dumb guys you met at the mall? Why? Because they were hitting on you?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Not that hitting on you would be crazy or anything... I just meant...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I think you should change the subject. Now.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Dinah, things have gone terribly. We really need to ace this last step. Any more suggestions?
A short while later, Howard and Brendan crest a hill and gaze down on the enemy base camp.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Look! There's the other team!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Wow... They look pretty well-fortified.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, they're way too entrenched for a direct assault. You'll need to draw their fire while I sneak in to steal the flag.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Just make sure not to get hit.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Okay. I'll do my best.
A few moments later, Brendan assumes position on the other side of the enemy camp.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Okay... Enemy sighted.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Hoo haa! I just love the smell of lip balm in the morning! Seriously, cracked lips are a real problem in dry climates.

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: Kzztt! Monte, you've been warned to keep this channel clear. Enemy forces have been spotted in area. Kzztt!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Time to make my move. I'll need to make a lot of noise to draw the enemy's attention!
Brendan leaps up, screaming like an enraged baboon!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Who...? What...?
Brendan fires several shots toward Officer Monte, spins on his heels, and then dashes into the protected treeline.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Wait! Come back here! And stop moving so dang much! I want to hit you with a paintball!
A few moments later, Brendan emerges from the woods at the base camp.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Great work, soldier! Mission accomplished. While you distracted the enemy, Howard captured the enemy flag.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Awesome!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You know, Brendan... I was skeptical at first, but all of this activity really helped me get my mind off of Linda.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I can't wait to tell Dinah... This mission idea really worked!
Brendan leaps up, opens his mouth to scream... But instead launches into a massive coughing fit!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hack! Gasp!
As Brendan chokes and sputters, his paintball gun accidentally goes off, launching a barrage of paintballs across the encampment and striking... Howard!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: YOWCH!!!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Heh. Look at what we have here, some enemy actors. My guess is 'Bonnie' here was planning to distract me while 'Clyde' over there ran off with my flag.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Only it didn't work, did it? You couldn't put one over on ol' Monte.
Monte cocks his paintball gun ominously.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: And now, Ol' Monte... He's gonna put one over on you.
Monte fires a volley of paintballs!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: YOWCH!!!
Twenty minutes later, Brendan and Howard emerge from the woods. They find Spike standing with Mallika.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Oh poor baby... Did those big, bad paintballers hurt you?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I'll be fine. No thanks to those two jokers. After they botched the raid on the enemy encampment, I was left alone and outnumbered.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: It was like something out of 'Paintpocalypse Now'.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Come here. Let me kiss it, and I'll make it all better.
Spike and Mallika begin making out.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Brendan, this is terrible. You brought me here to take my mind off of losing Linda.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Now, not only am I covered head to toe in welts, but I have to watch Spike make out with Mallika until our ride gets here.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Mmmm.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Mmmm.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Sorry, Howard... But I promise we'll figure something out.
Later that night...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: The enemy camp is just beyond that ridge. Your mission, should you choose to prove how awesome you are, is to retrieve their flag... By any means necessary!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I will remain behind to guard the base. You have your orders, soldiers. Fire Team Alpha, roll out!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Cool! Let's go!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What...? No, I...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Ten-four! I like your enthusiasm, soldier! You can take point!
Spike hands Howard a paintball gun.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Go on, soldier. Give it a try.
Howard squeezes off a few rounds.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey! This is pretty fun! I mean... Hoohaa, Lieutenant. Private Howard is confirmed green light for mission actual.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hey! This is working! Howard is really getting into it!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: What about you, Private Brendan? Are you ripe and ready for Operation Splat-tastic?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Sir! Yes, sir!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Good to hear it!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Excuse me?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Spike, listen... Howard and I are just here to run around and have a good time. You don't have to go overboard with the military jargon.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Good time?! Good time?! Skateboarding is a good time! Doing Sunday crosswords is a good time!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Out here on the paintball range, this is war. Make even one mistake... You're gonna go home looking like a Jason Poleax painting. Do you copy that, private?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh... Yeah?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I did not hear you!
Howard stiffens and salutes!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yes, sir! We hear you loud and clear, sir!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Huh... Howard actually seems to be getting into this now. Maybe I should've played along from the start.
Spike issues paintball guns to Brendan and Howard.

nodes.prompt: Make some noise to distract Officer Monte!

nodes.text: The next evening...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay... So we're here. The absolute middle of nowhere. What is it we're supposed to be doing again?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: According to Dinah, the second step to getting over a failed relationship is to go on a mission.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: A mission...? To do what?
Fftt! Fftt! Two brightly-colored projectiles whiz past Howard's head and strike the trunk of a nearby tree. They splatter, releasing sticky gobs of paint!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: That, actually!
Spike emerges from the bushes. He wields a `paintball gun!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Spike emerges from the bushes. He wields a [b]paintball gun![/b]

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Attention, soldiers! You grunts have been selected for a very dangerous mission. You will assist me in the capture and safe return of a flag now held by enemy forces.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wait...? What...?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: What's that, private? Am I meant to understand that you do not understand the rules of `Capture the Flag?`
nodes.text_bbcode: What's that, private? Am I meant to understand that you do not understand the rules of [color=#e23b3b][i]Capture the Flag?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No, of course I do. I just...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh... Spike, I think what Howard is saying is...

nodes.prompt: I think what Howard is saying is...

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: I think what Howard is saying is...

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: You're at this party to help Howard get over his ex-girlfriend. Did you ever stop to consider that maybe you need to do the same?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Whoa... I hadn't, but now that you put it that way.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yo, B-Dizzle! Time to bounce!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh oh... Looks like I have to go.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Just think about what I said, Brendan.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I will, Raven! And thanks for everything!
That night, on the ride home...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: The girl I talked to was pretty great! I mean, sure, she's in college, and I'm just in high school so it wouldn't work out between us... But it did get me thinking.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I mean, there are plenty of cool girls out there! I'm sure there's someone else out there for me!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Awesome!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: This should help Howard get over Linda.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: The girl I talked to totally reminded me of Linda. She kept saying that I seemed like a nice guy, but there was no way we'd ever work out.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: But remember our deal... All that happened was because `I` chose poorly.
nodes.text_bbcode: But remember our deal... All that happened was because [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] chose poorly.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I know you're trying to help, Brendan, but I deserved everything that sorority girl said.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh boy... This could be very bad.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Scared? Come on, Brendan. Goths aren't `that` intimidating!
nodes.text_bbcode: Scared? Come on, Brendan. Goths aren't [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] intimidating!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: No! I'm not scared of Dinah! She's really sweet.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Okay? Then what?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: It's just... The last time I was in a relationship, the girl cheated on me. It hurt. I'm scared of that happening again.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: That was a really brave thing to admit, Brendan. I can see why Dinah likes you.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Cool!

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Now let me clue you in on something you seem to have overlooked...

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Not ready?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah...

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Not ready?! That's your reason?! Brendan, how much time do you think you have? Dinah is graduating this year.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh... Well, I hadn't really thought about it like that... It's just that I was in a relationship that went bad and...

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Kid, you seem a little dense, so let me clue you in on something you seem to have overlooked...
The guys step into a college party in full swing.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wow! Good work, Brendan. You totally got us into the party!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, this place is bumpin'!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: And there are plenty of hot girls to talk to. Howard, all you have to do is pick one.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay... But what if I pick wrong? I mean... I've been in a relationship for six months. I'm way out of practice.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Uh oh... Looks like our boy has a case of the nerves.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hmm... I have a plan. I'll walk around the party and select a girl for you to talk to.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: If you hit it off with her, great. If not, we can say that I chose poorly. Sound good?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sure! Just, you know, don't pick anyone too wrong for me. I'm not sure my ego could take it.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I'll do my best! Okay, I'm off!
Brendan cruises through the party, scanning the crowd until...

nodes.speaker: Sorority Sister
nodes.text: I know, right? I totally did the bad boy thing for a while, but it grew so stale. Relationships are about more than fast cars and wild times.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Wow! She sounds perfect!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Um, excuse me...?

nodes.speaker: Sorority Sister
nodes.text: Yes? Can I help you?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Actually... I was hoping I could introduce you to a friend of mine. He's standing right over there.

nodes.speaker: Sorority Sister
nodes.text: Who? Oh... You mean the cute one?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah! Him!
Brendan introduces the sorority girl to Howard. The two immediately hit it off!

nodes.speaker: Sorority Sister
nodes.text: You really broke out of Boot Camp?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah! It was just like that movie 'The Pretty Awesome Escape'... Only my buds and I were `totally` awesome.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah! It was just like that movie 'The Pretty Awesome Escape'... Only my buds and I were [color=#e23b3b][i]totally[/i][/color] awesome.

nodes.speaker: Sorority Sister
nodes.text: Wow! You're so brave! And so considerate! Tell me more!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Look at Howard working it. He's like his old self again. I guess I picked really well!
Brendan cruises through the party, scanning the crowd until...

nodes.speaker: Sorority Sister
nodes.text: I know, right? Back in high school, this guy who liked me threw this big party in my honor and then sang my favorite song...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Wow! She sounds perfect!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Um, excuse me...?

nodes.speaker: Sorority Sister
nodes.text: Yes? Can I help you?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Actually... I was hoping that I could introduce you to a friend of mine. He's standing right over there.

nodes.speaker: Sorority Sister
nodes.text: Who? Oh... Him? I'm not sure he's my type.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: No, trust me! You'll love him!
Brendan introduces Howard to the sorority sister. The two begin to talk.

nodes.speaker: Sorority Sister
nodes.text: ...Which is when this other guy pulled up on a motorcycle. And I was all like, 'Nice ride'. And he was all like, 'Hop on, babe'.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Did you say... 'Motorcycle'?

nodes.speaker: Sorority Sister
nodes.text: Yeah! Bad boys who like to go fast are just so hot!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah... That's what I've heard.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh oh... Howard doesn't look happy at all. I think I picked poorly.
As Brendan turns away from Howard, he notices one girl in particular.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Huh?! Is that Dinah talking to that guy over there?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: No, it can't be... Can it?!
Brendan taps the girl on the shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Dinah, is that...?

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Uh... Can I help you?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: No, I'm sorry... From behind you looked like my friend, Dinah, and I thought...

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Dinah? From Centerscore High...?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah! Err... But not me. I go to college, and...

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Relax, kid. Your secret is safe with me... Any friend of Dinah's is cool in my book.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Cool!
An hour later...

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Wow... It sounds like you and Dinah are really good friends.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah! We are!

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Did you ever think that you two could be more than that?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I guess I've thought about it, but... The truth is I'm...

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Sorry, but you boys don't exactly look like M.A.N. material.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What? No! We totally are!

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Well, I suppose it's possible that admission standards have slipped a little. Tell you what... Why don't you wait here while I find the M.A.N. pledgemaster? If he vouches for you, I'll let you in.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh... That sounds... Great?

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Cool. Be right back.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Brendan, what were you thinking? O.M.G. and M.A.N. go way back! You needed to pick a fraternity she doesn't know anything about!
Glancing through the window, Howard spies the sorority sister returning to the front door with a beefy frat boy in tow.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh, guys... I think she's coming back.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Quick! Run!
Hector, Brendan, and Howard race to the rear of the Sorority house.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Huff! Huff! That was close. Guess we're not making it into the party.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Don't give up hope yet. Look! The back door has been propped open with a cinder block.
Hector, Howard, and Brendan step through the back door and enter the party.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: A.K.A.? I've never heard of that fraternity... And it sounds vaguely suspicious.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Well, the thing is... It's supposed to.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Our fraternity emphasizes the ancient Greek values of discretion, valor, and anonymity. You've never heard of us because you're not supposed to have heard of us.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: And if I did, you'd have to kill me, right?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Exactly!

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Well, I'm not convinced you three are frat boys, but I do think you're pretty funny!
The sorority sister steps aside and allows Hector, Howard, and Brendan to enter the party.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Come on in!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Okay, so this is the final night of your big plan to help me get over Linda. Where are we headed?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: We're going to a party to introduce you to some girls.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: A party... You mean like at somebody's house?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Somebody's house? Seriously, bro, would I be looking this sharp if we were headed to somebody's house? This look is way too premium blend for a high school party!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: If it's not a high school party, then... Where are we going?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: The `Omega Mu Gamma` house is throwing a party at Centerscore University tonight. It's supposed to be off the hook!
nodes.text_bbcode: The [color=#e23b3b][i]Omega Mu Gamma[/i][/color] house is throwing a party at Centerscore University tonight. It's supposed to be off the hook!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wait! We're going to a... Sorority party?!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You can pick your jaw up off the floor, good buddy. Hector Hector Alonzo always comes through for his friends.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But what about Amanda... Is she okay with you going to a sorority party alone?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: First of all, I'm not alone. I'm going with you. And second, Amanda recognizes how important a wingman can be. Now try to relax, bro... It's going to be great!
Hector parks his Party Van on Sorority Row. Together, the three guys approach the girl standing watch at the front door.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey there! My friends and I are here to attend this soiree.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Um... You guys look a little young to be frat brothers. Which house did you say you belong to again?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Oh, that's easy! We belong to...

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Not you. You're the talker. I want to hear the answer from him.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Me?

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: What's the matter? Don't know which fraternity you belong to?
Glancing across the street, Brendan spies a fraternity house named `Mu Alpha Nu.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Glancing across the street, Brendan spies a fraternity house named [b]Mu Alpha Nu.[/b]

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What do I do? Should I go with M.A.N., or should I try to make something up?

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Well...?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Of course, I know what fraternity I belong to. I'm just a freshman now, but I already practically live at the frat house. I belong to...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: And the paintball match was really fun!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: But the paintball match was really fun!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: And the paintball match went terribly.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: And to cap it off, the sorority party was a big success!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: So it was a good thing that the sorority party was such a big success!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: And to cap it off, the sorority party was a disaster!
Great... But not quite `perfect.` Try again and see if you can unlock the special bonus scene!
nodes.text_bbcode: Great... But not quite [b]perfect.[/b] Try again and see if you can unlock the special bonus scene!

A result that good can only mean one thing: you played a `great game.`

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Are you asking me out?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Brendan, the truth is I've liked you for a really long time too. And I was hoping that someday you'd ask me out...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I just wish that day had come sooner.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh... What?!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Remember that guy I met at the mall? Well, he called me up and... We're going to a Horror Movie Festival this weekend!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: But don't worry... I'll still make time to hang out with you... As a friend.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Anyway, got to run! My date's supposed to call me at ten tonight to plan which movies we're going to see!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Take care!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: But... But...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Look Brendan, I appreciate what you were trying to do for me, but it didn't work. I played worse than ever...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And it's all `YOUR FAULT!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: And it's all [color=#e23b3b][i]YOUR FAULT!!![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh... Wait a second. I was only trying to help!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Exactly my point! You said you wanted to help me get my mind off of Linda, but instead of doing that, you kept reminding me of how great it was to be with her!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: After the game I played tonight, I'll be lucky to ride the bench. I think I stand a good chance of getting cut from the team!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Howard, I'm sorry. I really tried...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Save it.
Howard slouches off, his head bowed in shame.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I failed! Howard seems worse than ever!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Maybe so, but there's nothing more we can do tonight.

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: Centerscore hikes the ball. The quarterback is looking deep. He passes, and...

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: Howard lets the ball slip through his hands! Incomplete pass!

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: They only had one chance, and they blew it! `Centerscore loses!`
nodes.text_bbcode: They only had one chance, and they blew it! [color=#e23b3b][i]Centerscore loses![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Football Player
nodes.text: By jings! We couldna claimed victory if Centerscore High hadna played that terrible wide receiver. His buttery fingers handed us the game!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: So it was really unfortunate that the sorority party was such a disaster.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: But the paintball match went terribly.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I mean, the video I played for him was a total disaster...

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: Honestly, I'm not so sure.
The next night, Brendan and Dinah sit in the bleachers, watching the closing minutes of the football game...

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: So, do you think Howard is doing better now?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Well, all we can do now is watch... And hope for the best.
After the game, Howard walks over to Brendan and Dinah.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Actually, Dinah... Before we go, there's something I've been meaning to say to you.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: While helping Howard, I realized he wasn't the only one that had problems because of a break-up...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Are you talking about Zach?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah, him too. But really, I meant me.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: The thing is... I like you. But I didn't do anything about it because I was worried about getting hurt again.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: But maybe... If you'd be willing that is... We could... You know...?

args.text: Surviving High School
Thanks for playing! See you in another episode!
Surviving High School
Give it another shot! You can do it!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Well, you're not done yet. I just finished hanging out with Linda, and I have some ideas about what you should do next. Come over, and we can talk about them.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Okay, I'll be right there.
Twenty minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Tonight, Linda and I went on a trip to East Ayeville. She helped me locate shimmery black velvet for the cloak I'm making. I think she responded well to having a 'mission'.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Dinah, that's...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Well, okay... Today, Linda and I were hanging out at the food court in the mall. While we were there, these two boys came over and started talking to us.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: It wasn't a big deal, but Linda felt better knowing that guys were still attracted to her.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Boys...? Were you talking to them too?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Yeah. I mean, I guess so... Do you care?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Of course, I care! I'm...
search

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Brendan, I understand what you're trying to do for Howard, and I'd love to help you find some footage of Howard and Linda together...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: But unfortunately, Mrs. Lumiere, the A.V. Studies instructor, is really paranoid about who gets access to the film vault.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I think it has something to do with the time that Wilson High inserted footage of a dancing badger into the school's welcome video.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Mallika, I wouldn't be asking if this wasn't important.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Um... Well... Fine. Fine! I'll help... But I'm only doing this because I feel sorry for Howard, and I want him to be happy.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Now, I know Mrs. Lumiere keeps the key to the film vault around here somewhere. If you could find it before she gets back from lunch, you should be able to open the vault and select a few tapes.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: In the meantime, I'll stand guard outside and let you know when Mrs. Lumiere gets back. Are you ready?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Time's wasting! Let's do this!
As Mallika steps out into the hall, Brendan searches the A.V. Studies classroom from top to bottom...
And finds the key!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Ha! It was under a snow globe with the word 'Rosebud' painted on the base... How much more obvious could you be?
Brendan uses the key to open the door to the film vault. He steps inside...
And finds himself in a room stacked floor-to-ceiling with digital videotapes, hard drives, and film canisters.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Whoa! There are thousands of movies in here... And that's just from this year?! How could they possibly record this much footage?
Brendan carefully thumbs through the labels and selects several promising titles. Then from outside the classroom, Brendan hears...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Kaw-Kaw! Kaw-kaw!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: That's the signal! Time to book!
Brendan steps out into the hallway.

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Lumiere
nodes.text: Mallika, I'm very disappointed in you. You know the A.V. Lab access rules!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: But he... He...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: But I'm in your third period class!

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Lumiere
nodes.text: You are? You don't look very familiar.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: That's because I'm... I'm wearing movie make-up to dramatically change my appearance. Just like in that one film you like...

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Lumiere
nodes.text: Oh! You mean 'The Pinkish Scarpernel'! I do love that movie! Weren't the special effects innovative?

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Lumiere
nodes.text: Well, if you know I love that movie, I guess you really must be in my class. Carry on.
Mrs. Lumiere exits into her classroom.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Whoo! That was close. Good thinking, Brendan!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: And thank you, Mallika. I'm sure these tapes will help Howard.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Perfect! Now all I have to do is invite Howard over for an impromptu movie night!
But comes up empty!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I've checked inside film canisters, behind the movie posters, and even underneath the editing bays. The key isn't anywhere!
From outside the classroom, Brendan hears...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Kaw-Kaw!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: So soon...? Oh well. Better to leave empty-handed than to get caught red-handed.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: That was close, Brendan! Too close. And you didn't even get the tape, did you?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I looked all around, but...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Save it... Just go wait outside, and I'll see what I can do.
A few moments later, Mallika exits the school. She crosses to Brendan.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: After you left, Mrs. Lumiere opened up the vault to retrieve footage of the football team.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: While she was inside, I managed to grab two tapes for you. They're not the best, but there might be something you can use to cheer Howard up.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Wow... Thanks, Mallika!
The next evening...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay... So we're here. The absolute middle of nowhere. What is it we're supposed to be doing again?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: According to Dinah, the second step to getting over a failed relationship is to go on a mission.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: A mission...? To do what?
Fftt! Fftt! Two brightly-colored projectiles whiz past Howard's head and strike the trunk of a nearby tree. They splatter, releasing sticky gobs of paint!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: That, actually!
Spike emerges from the bushes. He wields a `paintball gun!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Spike emerges from the bushes. He wields a [b]paintball gun![/b]

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Attention, soldiers! You grunts have been selected for a very dangerous mission. You will assist me in the capture and safe return of a flag now held by enemy forces.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wait...? What...?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: What's that, private? Am I meant to understand that you do not understand the rules of `Capture the Flag?`
nodes.text_bbcode: What's that, private? Am I meant to understand that you do not understand the rules of [color=#e23b3b][i]Capture the Flag?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No, of course I do. I just...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh... Spike, I think what Howard is saying is...

nodes.prompt: I think what Howard is saying is...

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: I think what Howard is saying is...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Okay, so this is the final night of your big plan to help me get over Linda. Where are we headed?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: We're going to a party to introduce you to some girls.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: A party... You mean like at somebody's house?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Somebody's house? Seriously, bro, would I be looking this sharp if we were headed to somebody's house? This look is way too premium blend for a high school party!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: If it's not a high school party, then... Where are we going?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: The `Omega Mu Gamma` house is throwing a party at Centerscore University tonight. It's supposed to be off the hook!
nodes.text_bbcode: The [color=#e23b3b][i]Omega Mu Gamma[/i][/color] house is throwing a party at Centerscore University tonight. It's supposed to be off the hook!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wait! We're going to a... Sorority party?!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You can pick your jaw up off the floor, good buddy. Hector Hector Alonzo always comes through for his friends.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But what about Amanda... Is she okay with you going to a sorority party alone?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: First of all, I'm not alone. I'm going with you. And second, Amanda recognizes how important a wingman can be. Now try to relax, bro... It's going to be great!
Hector parks his Party Van on Sorority Row. Together, the three guys approach the girl standing watch at the front door.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey there! My friends and I are here to attend this soiree.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Um... You guys look a little young to be frat brothers. Which house did you say you belong to again?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Oh, that's easy! We belong to...

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Not you. You're the talker. I want to hear the answer from him.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Me?

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: What's the matter? Don't know which fraternity you belong to?
Glancing across the street, Brendan spies a fraternity house named `Mu Alpha Nu.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Glancing across the street, Brendan spies a fraternity house named [b]Mu Alpha Nu.[/b]

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What do I do? Should I go with M.A.N., or should I try to make something up?

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Well...?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Of course, I know what fraternity I belong to. I'm just a freshman now, but I already practically live at the frat house. I belong to...

nodes.text: Step back, clan members! I'm activating my Teslonian Lightning Staff!

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: Ha! Countered with my Ice Shield!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh no! I've taken critical frost damage!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Don't worry, Brendizzle! These polar paw bandages will heal your...

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Yo, nerd!

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: Gulp... Yes?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Not you. The other one... Bernard.

nodes.speaker: Brendan

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Don't worry, Brendizzle! These polar paw bandages will heal your...
Suddenly, the overhead lights flicker on. Zach enters. He smells strongly of perspiration.

nodes.speaker: Zach

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: Gulp... Yes?

nodes.speaker: Zach

options.label: I don't have time for this.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: And I think it worked!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Dinah, things have gone great so far, but we need to finish this right. Any more suggestions?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Dinah, things have gone okay so far, but the final step will be crucial. Any more suggestions?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: I think so!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: I mean, the video I played for him was illuminating...

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: Centerscore hikes the ball. The quarterback looks deep. He passes. Howard makes the catch and steps into the end zone!

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: Touchdown! Centerscore wins!

nodes.speaker: Football Player
nodes.text: Help ma boab! Highlands Academy didna stand a chance with Howard playing for Centerscore High!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Thanks for helping me clear my head, Brendan. Getting benched would've been a serious blow to my ego.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But after tonight's game, my position on the team is secure!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: It's okay! What are friends for?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Just remember... Next time, don't try to hide what you're feeling. We're your friends. We want to help.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You're right!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Anyway, I noticed a couple of Highlands Academy hotties spectating the game. I have a feeling they'd love a chance to talk to the star wide receiver of Centerscore High.
Howard strides over to two kilt-clad cuties.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Look at that! We did it! Howard is back to his old self again!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Wow! He sure is!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I guess that means our work here is done.
Brendan steps forward and kisses Dinah!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Brendan, that was... That was...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: That was everything I ever imagined!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Really? I don't know what came over me. I was just... I mean, I... Wow! I totally just kissed you!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Brendan, it's okay! The truth is I've liked you for a really long time, too.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I never told you because I wanted you to be ready for me.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Believe me, I'm ready!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Me too!
Brendan and Dinah kiss again!
In fact, you were `perfect!` Enjoy your bonus scene!
nodes.text_bbcode: In fact, you were [b]perfect![/b] Enjoy your bonus scene!

nodes.text: You saw firsthand how Brendan helped Howard get over the break-up, but how did Dinah comfort Linda? Let's find out!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Dinah, I'm not so sure we're supposed to be in the cemetery after dark.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Relax. According to this book of folk remedies I read, getting scared is the perfect cure for a broken heart.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Getting 'scared'...?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Yep. Now I know there was a creepy tombstone around here somewhere.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Uh oh...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: What?! Are we lost?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: No, I just remembered something. Getting scared is how you cure `hiccups.` I was supposed to brew you chamomile tea.
nodes.text_bbcode: No, I just remembered something. Getting scared is how you cure [color=#3b78e2][i]hiccups.[/i][/color] I was supposed to brew you chamomile tea.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I guess there's no point sticking around here any...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Doom
nodes.text: doooooooommm....

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: What was that?!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I don't know!!!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Who cares?! Let's get out of here!!!
A few minutes later, Dinah and Linda catch their breath in a nearby parking lot...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Well, that wasn't exactly how I planned on spending my Friday night, but it `did` get my mind off of Howard. So thanks, Dinah. I really appreciate you helping me out.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, that wasn't exactly how I planned on spending my Friday night, but it [color=#3b78e2][i]did[/i][/color] get my mind off of Howard. So thanks, Dinah. I really appreciate you helping me out.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Uh... Don't thank me yet. I think we might have to go back into the cemetery.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: What?! Why?! We barely made it out the first time!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Because it was scary and I... I...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: HICCUP!
Try playing our Premium Content Mega Pack, Homecoming Queen!
It's a battle for the crown between the most popular girls at Centerscore High! Do you have what it takes to beat Paula and become the new Homecoming Queen? Play now to find out!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Thanks for helping me out, Brendan. I'm not totally over Linda yet, but I played better tonight than at the last few practices.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: The coach says I may have to sit out a few games this season, but at least my spot on the team is secure.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Wow... I'm just sorry I couldn't do more.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's okay. Anyway, I better go...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: The coach has me on towel duty. See ya!
Howard slouches off to collect the sweaty, grass-stained towels strewn about the field.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Well, it definitely worked... Sorta. Howard didn't go too crazy on the field tonight, but he also didn't play very well.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Maybe so, but there's nothing more we can do tonight.

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: Centerscore hikes the ball. The quarterback looks deep. He passes... Howard makes the catch and is immediately tackled.

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: The score is `tied` 14-14 as the clock runs down on the third overtime! Looks like neither Centerscore High nor Highlands Academy will win tonight!
nodes.text_bbcode: The score is [color=#e23b3b][i]tied[/i][/color] 14-14 as the clock runs down on the third overtime! Looks like neither Centerscore High nor Highlands Academy will win tonight!

nodes.speaker: Football Player
nodes.text: Crivvens! A tie! I didna believe it was possible!

nodes.speaker: Television
nodes.text: Well... I hope so!
